answer_1.quote: we examine whether NLG models can 1) compose actions that satisfy goals while observing normative constraints, 2) generate plausible consequences of actions, and 3) produce norms that explain the difference between appropriate and inappropriate actions.

answer_2.quote: Generation quality was assessed using a combination of automatic metrics and human evaluation. The former relies on BLEU and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: human evaluation was conducted by expert workers who contributed at least 25 high-quality stories to the dataset.
answer_4.guideline: Assess coherence, intention fulfillment, and norm constraint observance for actions; coherence and plausibility for consequences; coherence and relevance for norms.
